title: PaymentAllocated
description: Emitted once a payment amount has been split into fees, interest and principal (allocation order: late fees -> interest -> principal).

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the aggregate (the payment id).

feeAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to outstanding late fees.

interestAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to accrued interest.

principalAmount.description: Portion of the payment applied to principal.
